name: tonymelek-portfolio
description: Tony Melek portfolio — Vite + Tailwind + Handlebars static site

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm run build:css && npm run build:pages
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n css,pages,serve -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:css" "npm run dev:pages" "npm run dev:serve"
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx --yes serve dist -p 4173
